items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: Oh, Joe Murphy's one band, I don't remember. In the band? The other one, I don't know who was.

ctx.x: Do you remember whose band it was or who else he played with?
Oh, Joe Murphy's one band, I don't remember. In the band? The other one, I don't know who was. The other one was there.
What did he play at, Joe Murphy?
